report.heading: Report content
report.intro: A report contests an Arena, an argument or a profile with closed reasons. It never removes content by itself.
report.rate_note: Too many reports in a row. Wait before reporting again.

appeal.heading: Appeal a sanction
appeal.intro: An appeal contests one sanction inside the window. One appeal contests one action.

failure.invalid: This request is not valid. Check the reason and try again.
failure.unauthorized: Sign in to report or appeal.
failure.forbidden: This account cannot do this right now.
failure.step_up: Confirm your identity again to continue.
failure.missing: This content or sanction no longer exists.
failure.conflict: This request conflicts with the current state.
failure.generic: It could not be filed. Check and try again.

workbench.heading: Moderation workbench
workbench.intro: Triage queue for active moderators. Role and second factor are revalidated per call.
